svg.title: S3NTINEL current V2 architecture single-pane reference
svg.desc: Current Spark-oriented fitting and inference stages, active artifacts, mathematical representations, validation, replay, and implementation boundaries.
svg.text: CURRENT V2 ARCHITECTURE • SINGLE-PANE REPOSITORY REFERENCE
Structural Streaming Sparse Event Nexus for Telemetry Inference with Network Envelope Learning
Spark evidence pipeline • persisted artifacts • simulation-backed validation
Grouped runners: 97 fitting • 98 inference • 99 full • 96 fixed-reference inference
35 WINDOW FEATURES APPLY • reference inference only • fixed scaling profile • no structural refit
72 PHASE LABEL CENTROIDS • simulation validation only • truth labels • excluded from production grouped runners
Spark-oriented telemetry anomaly detection and attribution with a simulation validation harness.
• Motivated by A-MATS-captured ARINC 664 Part 7 / AFDX avionics telemetry and CBM+ investigation.
• Consumes normalized observed telemetry and emits calibrated anomaly evidence plus attribution artifacts.
• Does not currently claim live A-MATS, AFDX, or BLADE integration.
parameter_value drives fitting and inference; parameter_value_clean is simulation truth/debug context only.
window_policy_profile selects max duration and event threshold; stage 30 materializes windows.
window_features = ZOH continuous state at t_end + scaled vectors + categorical state + event counts/summaries + drift.
• datatype, scaling, behavior, event, window-policy, backbone, graph, hierarchy, and phase artifacts
• phase_reference_model persists feature config, robust statistics, ordered centroids, scales, and
• target observations rematerialize events, windows, and features before fixed-model phase application
Reference inference does not rerun stages 10, 12, 15, 25, 40, 50, or 60 and does not fit phase structure from
full fit + inference under one parent MLflow run
Grouped runners support stage slicing and replay from manifests whose replayable_from inputs are valid.
• Canonical labels use *_label; detector fields use *_detected.
• Co-occurrence and precedence are graph relations, not detector event types.
• Persisted artifact and field names come from schemas and the glossary.
The reconstruction backbone summarizes normal continuous structure over robust-scaled end-of-window
G = Σw xCᵀxC • H = Σw xCᵀx
Event summaries influence sensor ranking only; they do not enter G/H or the ridge solve.
nearest-prior, per-band conditional tendency → collapsed compatibility weight
delayed temporal relation with support and lag bands
weighted compatible components; directed evidence retained separately
combined evidence for bounded hierarchy fitting
• Stage 60 consumes persisted fused_graph + graph_parameter_universe from the same fitting run.
• Spark ranks neighbors and retains mutual top-k edges; only the pruned result reaches bounded clustering/rollup.
• hierarchy_sensor_map assigns parameter → module → subsystem → system IDs.
• hierarchy_edge_evidence preserves endpoint ranks, fused components, hierarchy IDs, and directed lag evidence both
Temporal direction supplies evidence; it does not become a containment or causal direction.
• Selected structure vectors → Spark-first per-flight clustering → progress-mass seeding → ordered support bands.
• Monotone transition-aware decode + minimum dwell emits phase_windows and phase_baselines.
• Primary phases: gate_turnaround, takeoff_climb, cruise, descent_approach.
• Auxiliary stable / transition_region metadata does not add a fifth learned phase.
A fleet-learned revisitable transition model is outside the current contract.
WindowScoresRawTable combines fitted phase and structural context; WindowScoresCalibratedTable converts
emit_ready requires a warm-enough phase bucket and medium/high raw severity—or a phase-rare low-severity window.
parameter_score_evidence is bounded diagnostic payload; it does not change severity or emission semantics.
Stage 90 filters calibrated windows and materializes inspectable evidence without reimplementing scoring.
dominant system / subsystem / module + panel context
one row per emitted window/parameter candidate; rank + cuts + hierarchy
Attribution cannot recover targets absent from upstream score evidence or the retained hierarchy.

backbone • sensor energy • component graphs • fused graph • hierarchy

window • telemetry • event • parameter candidate evidence
stage manifests • pipeline summary • harness • objective • benchmark ledgers
• validation_harness_report joins fit parameters, model metrics, compute metrics, simulator context, and lineage.
• objective_evaluation_report ranks comparable runs by mode-aware quality with separate compute tie-breaks.
• benchmark tiers separate detection, parameter, subsystem, and module eligibility and failure diagnosis.
• Phase evaluation separates steady-phase macro F1, exact transition-window overlap, and boundary-event alignment.
Simulation evidence is scoped to authored truth and declared recoverability; it is not operational aircraft-performance
• Every stage persists output tables, summary JSON, manifest, input/output inventory, row counts, and wall time.
• Grouped runs produce pipeline/full-run summaries, validation and objective reports, per-stage manifests, and
• Replay resumes only when the first resumed stage has valid replayable_from inputs.
• Graph and hierarchy artifacts must remain from one fitting run; stage 60 consumes persisted graph evidence rather
Fixed artifacts + immutable manifests make model comparisons inspectable and reversible.
• Stage 20 uses segmented Spark sequence kernels over (tail_id, flight_id, parameter_name).
• Stage 40 keeps facts distributed; only sensor-energy and per-flight G/H aggregates reach the final bounded solve.
• Stage 50 builds precision, event, lag, transition, and fusion in Spark; only pruned hierarchy edges cross to
• Stage 70 uses segmented Spark assignment; only bounded global configuration remains driver-side.
• Stage 80 keeps the main score fact table distributed and collects bounded reference artifacts.
No toPandas() on growing fact tables; collect() only explicitly bounded reference artifacts; fail fast above configured
Table / Frame / schema and merge contracts
Stages remain thin; domain growth belongs in the owning libs/* package.
• Current hot path is Spark Table / Frame; bounded local pandas is reporting, validation, evaluation, plotting, and
• window_features—not historical window_x—is the canonical many-window artifact.
• continuous_vector_t_end is the raw ZOH snapshot; event payloads do not overwrite it.
• Learned relations support behavioral structure and localization; they do not prove causality.
• Current calibration is phase-conditioned empirical tail rarity, narrower than a full conformal framework.
• The system emits evidence and explorer artifacts; automated fleet enforcement is not part of the current
